releases.title: Waybill numbers stay as you type them
releases.body:
### Fixes

- **A waybill number that you type now stays on its own load.** Before, the app put your number on every other load that had the same number. When you opened the day again, many rows showed one number.
- **The board saves the waybill numbers faster.** You can type the numbers down the column and not wait after each row. The app sends them together.

### Check your data

The app does not correct a waybill number from before this version. Open each day that shows a wrong number. Type the correct number on each row again. Your number stays now.

releases.title: Correct redeliver numbers, safe re-imports
releases.body:
### Fixes

- **A redeliver or a foul trip now keeps the original waybill number.** A redeliver of waybill AL-40 is AL-40-R. Before, the app gave the carry-over trip the next free number, such as AL-41-R.
- **The app does not import the same route file twice.** If an import fails and you try again, the app brings in only the freight orders (FO) that the date does not have yet. Before, a second attempt put another copy of every row on the dispatch board.

### What is new

- **You can delete several rows in one action.** Select the rows on the dispatch board. Click **✕ Delete** in the toolbar. The app deletes each selected trip that has no confirmed waybill. It keeps the trips that have one, and tells you how many it kept.

### Check your data

The app does not change a waybill number that it gave before this version. Look at the carry-over trips on your board. Correct a wrong -R or -FT number by hand before you confirm it.

releases.title: Manage the user accounts in the app
releases.body:
### What is new

- **An administrator can now manage the user accounts in the app.** Open **Settings**. Go to the **Users** section. You can add a user, change the role of a user and remove the access of a user.
- **A removed user keeps their history.** The app only takes away the access.
- **An administrator cannot change or remove their own account.** This keeps one administrator in the app at all times.
- **The app shows its version at the top right, on the left of your account name.** Click the version to open this box again. The account menu does not have the "What's new?" button any more.

This version also contains preparation work for Billing and Payroll (Phase 2).

releases.title: Correct numbers, and the status on the FINAL ROUTE page
releases.body:
### ⚠️ What you must do first

The app does not correct the trips and the waybills from before this update. Some loads from before show more than one Redeliver number.

**We recommend that the administrator deletes all the data one time, and then imports the route files again.** Open **Settings**. Go to **Danger zone — clear all data**.

The app deletes all the trips, the waybills and the outlets. The employees, the trucks and the waybill numbering stay.

### What is new

- **The FINAL ROUTE page shows the status of each trip.** The new Status column is between the Plate column and the Remarks column. You see it when you print the page or save it as an image.
- **A carried-over load keeps one waybill number.** Before, each stop of the load could receive a different Redeliver number. Now all the stops share one number.
- **Each trip and each waybill keeps its own number.** Before, two saves at the same moment could give one number to two trips. The app now saves one change at a time.
- **The app can show a new message: "The system is busy with another change. Please try again."** Wait a moment. Then do your change again.

### What is the same

Everything else is the same. This version also contains preparation work for Billing and Payroll (Phase 2). You do not see this work on the screen.

### What's new

- The **Admin** menu is now called **Settings**. It has the same tools as before.
- You can now set a color for each customer group in Settings. The dispatch board uses these colors to group trips.
- You can now edit a waybill number before you confirm it. Before, you had to confirm it first to fix a mistake.
- The dispatch board is easier to read. Rows and grid lines have more contrast.

Nothing else has changed. Your daily work stays the same.

releases.title: Clearer route file, and correct redelivery dates
releases.body:
### What is new

- **The FINAL ROUTE file has different columns.** The Area column is now the first column. The FO column is next to the Type column. The Restrictions column is gone from the printout, from the driver cards and from the Excel file.
- **A Redeliver now goes to the correct day.** Before, a Redeliver that you keyed in the next morning made a trip two days later. Now the app counts from the day of the original trip. This is also true for "Foul Trip - For Redeliver".
- **A merged load keeps one waybill number.** Before, each stop of a merged load received a different Redeliver number. Now all the stops of the load share one number, in the same way as a Regular waybill.
- **The Admin tab is new.** Only an administrator can see it. It holds a button that deletes all the trips, the waybills and the outlets. You must type a confirmation phrase before the app deletes anything.

### What is the same

Everything else is the same. The dispatch board, the route file import and the sign-in screen work as before.

releases.title: A new link, and a faster app
releases.body:
### What is new

- **The app has a new link.** The usual launcher link still works, and it opens the new link automatically. If you saved the old link in your browser, replace it with this link.
- **You can stay signed in to more than one Google account.** Before, the app sometimes showed the message "unable to open the file", and you had to sign out of the other accounts. This does not happen any more.
- **The app opens more quickly.** The first time you open it each day is much faster than before.
- **The sign-in screen looks different.** It shows the standard Google sign-in button. Use the same Google account as before.
- **This "What's new?" box is new.** It opens one time after each update. To open it again, click the account menu at the top right.

### What is the same

Everything else is the same. The dispatch board, the waybills, the route file import, the exports and the driver cards work as before. All your data is in the same place.
